name: Ottobock SE & Co. KGaA
summary: Ottobock SE & Co. KGaA develops, produces, and distributes medical technology products and components for the people with disabilities in the fields of prosthetics, orthotics, human mobility, and industrial exoskeletons in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, North and South America, and the Asia Pacific.
